_comment: The public Masinloc Connect Marketplace.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS RATHER THAN A LIVE QUERY
business_submissions lives in Supabase and predates this repository, so
there is no migration here describing it. More importantly there is no
public read path to it: the table has no anon SELECT policy, and the
columns a visitor may see have never been separated from the ones they may
not. Until it has that separation, a browser cannot be pointed at it without
risking owner_name, owner_email and owner_phone.
So this file carries only public-facing business information deliberately
reviewed for publication rather than queried indiscriminately. A row exists
here because it has been reviewed for the public directory, not because a
database filter happened to include it.
supabase/MARKETPLACE-LIVE-DATA.md describes what to deploy to move this to
a live feed, and what the page would then read.
NO PHONE NUMBERS OR EMAIL ADDRESSES, ANYWHERE
The public contact method is Facebook. Phone numbers and email addresses are
not held here at all — not in a private key, not commented out — because a
field that is absent from the data cannot leak into a page, a script, a data
attribute or a JSON-LD block by mistake. contact and contact_number are in
the generator's FORBIDDEN list, so re-adding one fails the build rather than
shipping.
Likewise owner_name, owner_email, owner_phone, reference codes, submission
ids, moderation status and dashboard-interest flags never appear here.
THE FACEBOOK LINKS ARE SHARE LINKS
Some entries use facebook.com/share/... URLs because those are the verified
public links supplied for the listing. They are published as-is. They are
not canonical Page URLs and nothing here describes them as such; rewriting
one into a cleaner-looking /pagename form would be inventing an address.
WHAT MAY AND MAY NOT APPEAR HERE
Public fields, matching what the edge function writes:
brand_name -> name, store_locations -> location,
short_description -> description, facebook_page -> facebook
'category', 'descriptor', 'schemaType' and 'metaDescription' have no column
behind them. They are editorial: how the business is classified, how it is
described in a search result, and which schema.org subtype is defensible for
it. They live here because a human decided them, not because a table did.
IMAGES
Logos are published only after they are separately reviewed and entered in
data/marketplace-logos.json. A business without an approved logo manifest
entry gets the intentional text-led card rather than a broken image.
